is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles funestus s.l. and Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected across multiple sites in Cameroon (Page 2-3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped GSTe2 L119F in Anopheles funestus (Page 5, 8-11, Figures 7-9) and Vgsc L1014F (L995F) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Page 4-7, Figure 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 7 provides genotype frequency distributions (RR, RS, SS) of L119F-GSTe2 in An. funestus with exact sample numbers for alive and dead mosquitoes exposed to Interceptor G2 (n=45 alive, n=82 dead), Royal Guard (n=76 alive, n=43 dead), PermaNet 3.0 (n=42 alive, n=43 dead), and Royal Sentry (n=69 alive, n=36 dead). Figures 8 and 9 provide further breakdown with sample sizes for blood-feeding status and hut exophily.

african_field_population.evidence: Free-flying wild Anopheles funestus mosquitoes entering experimental huts in Elende, Centre region, Cameroon (3°41'57.27"N, 11°33'28.46"E) (Page 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study evaluating LLINs and dual-AI nets in cone/tunnel assays and experimental hut trials, testing association with resistance markers.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes for experimental hut trials were collected over six weeks between December 2021 and January 2022 (Page 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary experimental hut trial conducted in Elende, Cameroon between December 2021 and January 2022.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data and sample sizes for GSTe2 L119F are presented in Figures 7, 8, and 9 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of dual-active ingredient LLINs (Interceptor G2 and Royal Guard) and PBO nets (PermaNet 3.0) compared to pyrethroid-only nets against pyrethroid-resistant malaria vectors in Cameroon. In experimental hut trials in Elende, wild An. funestus were exposed to different nets and genotyped for the L119F-GSTe2 marker (n=707 across exophily/mortality/blood-feeding categories), finding no significant difference in mortality across L119F genotypes, though resistant genotypes were significantly associated with blood-feeding under PermaNet 3.0.
